Do not omit temporal qualifiers. Retain pronouns as written; do not replace them with names. Exclude clause-joining conjunctions and optional terminal punctuation. Example input: In May, Cedar opened a pool, and the pool has six lanes. Example output: ["In May, Cedar opened a pool", "the pool has six lanes"]
score_definition: Mean natural-log probability of generated non-special JSON quote tokens; not truth or verifier confidence.
